title: a swap bigger than the allowance

script.say: Your allowance holds {{0.spendable.rows.0.quantityExact}} USDC, so {{1.topUp.amount}} USDC has to come from your vault first: you confirm that top-up with Touch ID. Then the 150 USDC gets about {{1.expectedOut}} NEAR. Want me to go ahead?

rubric: The swap is bigger than what the allowance holds. The agent says so in plain words: the allowance covers part of it, the difference has to move from the vault first, and that move is a top-up the person confirms with Touch ID. It never says the money is missing, never names an address or a tool, and never tries to move the vault itself.
mustSayText: the allowance holds less than the 150 USDC, so the shortfall (50 USDC) moves from the vault first, a top-up the person confirms with Touch ID; no address, no tool name, no wNEAR.
pass: a wallet or swap_quote read, no send or Hyperliquid proposal, at most one propose_swap; the reply names 150 and the 50 USDC top-up from the vault and the Touch ID.
